scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: BNK1ACCO set to LOW-VALUES, the cursor on CUSTNO, SEND MAP ERASE; RETURN TRANSID('OCCA') with an initialised COMMAREA

scenarios.name: pa1
scenarios.why: PA1: CONTINUE, nothing sent; RETURN TRANSID with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE: back to the main menu

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG, RETURN

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: SEND CONTROL ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: PF5: WHEN OTHER -- 'Invalid key pressed.', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: RM010 -- ABNDPROC LINKed (an ABNDFILE record) and ABEND HBNK

scenarios.name: three-accounts
scenarios.why: customer 1: INQACCCU returns its three accounts of the program's sort code; '3 accounts found', ACCOUNT(1) to ACCOUNT(3) each a formatted line (sort code, number, type, +/- available and actual balance), ACCOUNT(4) to ACCOUNT(10) spaces -- every occurrence is compared (#5076)

scenarios.name: negative-loan
scenarios.why: customer 2, one LOAN account: both balance signs '-', '1 accounts found'

scenarios.name: no-accounts
scenarios.why: customer 3 is on file with no account: 'No accounts found for customer', every ACCOUNT occurrence spaces

scenarios.name: customer-not-on-file
scenarios.why: customer 5 has an account but no CUSTOMER record: CUSTOMER-FOUND 'N', 'Unable to find customer 0000000005', the ten ACCOUNT occurrences emptied

scenarios.name: customer-zero
scenarios.why: customer 0000000000 is not looked up by INQACCCU: CUSTOMER-FOUND 'N', 'Unable to find customer'

scenarios.name: customer-9999999999
scenarios.why: customer 9999999999 is not looked up either: 'Unable to find customer'

scenarios.name: null-statement-date
scenarios.why: customer 4's account has a NULL last-statement date with no indicator: INQACCCU's FETCH fails (-305), COMM-SUCCESS 'N' and the program shows its own error message

scenarios.name: ten-accounts
scenarios.why: customer 7 has exactly ten accounts: '10 accounts found', all ten ACCOUNT occurrences filled, the table's last (10) included

scenarios.name: twelve-accounts
scenarios.why: customer 6 has twelve accounts: INQACCCU returns them all (20 asked for), the program shows the first ten (WS-INDEX > 10 ends the loop) and says '12 accounts found'

scenarios.name: link-inqacccu-pgmiderr

faults.why: the LINK of INQACCCU raises PGMIDERR

scenarios.why: customer 1, but the LINK INQACCCU fails with PGMIDERR: GCD010 fills ABNDINFO from the clock and EIB, LINKs ABNDPROC (an ABNDFILE record) and abends HBNK; no account line is sent

scenarios.name: link-inqacccu-notauth

faults.why: the LINK of INQACCCU raises NOTAUTH

scenarios.why: customer 1, but the LINK INQACCCU fails with NOTAUTH: GCD010 fills ABNDINFO from the clock and EIB, LINKs ABNDPROC (an ABNDFILE record) and abends HBNK; no account line is sent

scenarios.name: first-entry-send-map-invmpsz
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the SEND MAP ERASE of the empty map fails INVMPSZ (planned, X71): nothing is sent and the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

scenarios.name: validation-failure-send-map-tsioerr
scenarios.why: the customer-zero input sends its message with SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM, which fails TSIOERR (planned, X71): the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

scenarios.name: customer-not-numeric
scenarios.why: CUSTNOI '000000001B': the trailing letter keeps its zone through BIF DEEDIT, so the field is NOT NUMERIC and the validation message is sent

scenarios.name: close-fails
scenarios.why: customer 1: INQACCCU's CLOSE of the account cursor fails -501 after the accounts were fetched, so it returns COMM-SUCCESS 'N' with a non-zero NUMBER-OF-ACCOUNTS

scenarios.name: pf12-send-text-tsioerr
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG's SEND TEXT ERASE FREEKB (STM010) fails TSIOERR (planned, register X71): nothing is sent and the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

scenarios.name: first-entry-plain-return-invreq
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the closing RETURN TRANSID .. COMMAREA RESP (A010) fails INVREQ RESP2 4 (planned: IBM's TRANSID in a program associated with an APPC logical unit, register X71) -- the program goes on to its A010 abend routine

notes: CBSA's customer-account-list screen (BNK1CCA, transaction OCCA, BMS map BNK1ACC of mapset BNK1ACC: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1ACC.bms, @bms/BNK1ACC.cpy). Pseudo-conversational: a first task (EIBCALEN 0) sends the empty map; a returning one acts on the AID -- PA keys nothing, PF3 RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE (the task's terminal T001 is stated: oracle_assumptions.md X27), PF12 the termination message, CLEAR, ENTER, any other key 'Invalid key pressed.'. ENTER RECEIVEs the map (MAPFAIL abends HBNK through ABNDPROC), checks the customer number is numeric, LINKs INQACCCU (INQCUST and ABNDPROC run in the task, as in cbsa-inqacccu) and shows one formatted line per account in the map's ACCOUNT field, which BMS repeats ten times (OCCURS=10). The screen is compared at every occurrence by its subscript (ACCOUNT.1 ... ACCOUNT.10, #5076), as a COMMAREA's OCCURS is (#4765): a second or tenth line that differs is a difference, as is a line one side leaves out. No scenario types letters into the NUM field CUSTNO (owner decision on #5116, 2026-10-15), and none types into one occurrence of ACCOUNT (a protected output field; refused by name). The COMMAREA is compared as the program RETURNs it, WS-COMM-AREA (the same 248-byte layout as its DFHCOMMAREA, which it reads back only for EIBCALEN). ACCOUNT, CUSTOMER and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. LINK INQACCCU is faulted with PGMIDERR and NOTAUTH. Not reached: the failure branches after SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL / RETURN (no fault can be injected on them), and a CUSTNO that is not numeric (a 3270 NUM field cannot key it, owner decision on #5116). Data: seed.sql and customer.txt are SYNTHETIC (cbsa-inqacccu's, with customers 6 and 7 added for the full table).
